Raytheon Co., Marlborough, Massachusetts, has been awarded an $8,000,000,000 maximum ceiling, cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for the procurement of terminal developmental modernization, production restart services, and technical studies associated with Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center’s Strategic Communications Terminals. Work will be performed at Marlborough, Massachusetts; and Largo, Florida, and is expected to be completed by Oct. 12, 2036. This contract was a sole source acquisition. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $800,000 are being obligated at time of award. The Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center, Hanscom Air Force Base, Massachusetts, is the contracting activity (FA2293-27-D-B001). 
 
L3Harris Technologies Inc., Colorado Springs, Colorado, has been awarded a $33,141,075 modification (P00380) to previously awarded contract FA8823-20-C-0004 for the Unified Messaging System effort. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $1,527,155,327 from $1,494,014,252. Work will be performed in Colorado Springs, Colorado; and Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, and is expected to be completed by October 2028. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $2,419,579 are being obligated at the time of award. The Space Systems Command, Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado, is the contracting activity. (Awarded on Oct. 10, 2026). 
 
ITA International LLC,* Newport News, Virginia, has been awarded a $20,425,747 modification (P00022) to previously awarded contract FA4890-22-F-0024 for expeditionary security forces squadron staff support services supporting U.S. Air Forces Central. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $80,898,106 from $60,472,359. Work will be performed at Shaw Air Force Base, South Carolina; and various other locations, and is expected to be completed by Nov. 2, 2027. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $20,425,747 are being obligated at the time of award. The Headquarters Air Combat Command, Acquisition Management and Integration Center, Langley AFB, Virginia, is the contracting activity. (Awarded on Oct. 8, 2026).

General Dynamics Mission Systems Scottsdale, Arizona, has been awarded a $88,064,639 ceiling increase modification P00080 to previously awarded contract (HQ085022C0007) for Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture in support of the Tracking and Transport ground segment systems engineering integration and development. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $1,243,578,839 from $1,155,514,199. Work will be performed at Scottsdale, Arizona and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2029. Fiscal 2026 research development test and evaluation funds in the amount of $58,415,106 are being obligated at time of award. The Missile Warning and Tracking Portfolio Acquisition Executive, supported by the Space Development Agency, Washington, D.C, is the contracting activity.
